official_sources: Ofwat Code for Adoption evaluation response
official_measurement_examples: S104 agreement is an adoption route and not proof adoption has completed
technical acceptance is distinct from signed adoption agreement
developer remains responsible until formal adoption where applicable
early construction before completed agreement can be at developer risk
S104 adoption is distinct from S106 right of connection
private and public sewer status remain distinct
sewerage Code sector documents have applied to new applications since April 2020
May 2026 panel consultation is a consultation and must not be treated as an operative change until adopted
core_rules: S104 agreement is not completed adoption
signed agreement is not evidence all assets are adopted
S104 is distinct from S106 connection
sewer adoption is distinct from highway adoption
private sewer is not public sewer
developer responsibility continues until adoption evidence
early start does not guarantee adoption
Code standards do not prove as-built compliance
planning permission does not adopt sewers
adoption does not grant planning permission
consultation proposal is not operative rule
adoption does not establish land ownership
adoption does not prove network capacity
no parcel sewer clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Ofwat, Water Industry Act and regulated water-company developer sources checked 2026-07-26. Current Code framework and May 2026 consultation context retained; adoption/agreement/connection/status distinctions enforced; no parcel promotion.
